title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reading.body:
This is an undisclosed synthetic alteration of a real photograph, made in the production of university promotional material. A picture taken at a campus event was edited so that one student, Billy Ramirez, was replaced by a different person and the two others were reshaped, and the edited version was then published on campus banners as though it documented the event. The failure sits at the point where marketing material is prepared and approved, not in the model that produced the edit.

Stanford's own AI policy already prohibited using AI to create or change images of Stanford people and events, and the university has said the alteration and the absence of disclosure both broke it. Catching this therefore required no new rule. It required a review step that compared the banner against the source photograph, and a disclosure step that would have flagged the image as altered before it went up. The university has said it is adding training and changing how materials are reviewed.

What the reporting does not establish is intent, and it does not establish what consequences, if any, followed for the people involved.

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
In 2024, Stanford University's dining service posted a photo of Billy Ramirez, a Hispanic senior studying human biology, at a Lunar New Year party with two other students. Last week, when Stanford used the image on campus banners, Ramirez had been replaced by a Black woman, and the other students were made to look thinner. Ramirez learned about the change from a friend and said he was upset and frustrated, though he also saw a comedic side to it. Stanford acknowledged on Tuesday that it had used artificial intelligence to alter the original image.

Stanford said its AI policy strictly bans using AI to create or change images of Stanford people, events, research, facilities, or achievements. The university said both the change and the lack of disclosure broke that policy. It added that it is working with Residential and Dining Enterprises to add training and improve how all materials are reviewed.
title_en: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad
